transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

My family keeps telling me everything is normal, but I’m convinced they’re secretly working together behind my back, and I can’t shake that belief no matter what they show me. They all insist I'm imagining things, but I just know what they are doing.
How long have you felt this way about your family, and did this belief start suddenly after a specific event, or has it been developing gradually over several months?

This has been going on for about eleven months now, starting when we had all those arguments about selling my parents' house and sorting out the paperwork in Mexico. It didn't happen overnight, but as they kept delaying things and making excuses, it gradually became clear to me that they were coordinating to exclude me. Now, I am completely certain of what they are doing.
Besides your concerns about your family, have you noticed any other unusual experiences, such as hearing voices when no one is around or feeling like your thoughts are being broadcast to others?

No, absolutely not. I don't hear any voices when no one is around, and I've never felt like my thoughts are being broadcast to anyone. My only concern is what my family is secretly doing behind my back regarding my parents' estate.
Aside from your concerns about the estate, have you been able to maintain your usual daily routine, work, and social interactions, or has this situation caused significant disruption to your life?

My work is completely unaffected; I still manage my office team and volunteer at the senior center just fine. But my family life has been ruined because I now avoid gatherings, and when I do see my ex-husband and kids, I'm so tense that we just end up in huge arguments about their plans.
Apart from the tension and arguments regarding your family, have you noticed any other changes in your mood, energy levels, or ability to experience pleasure in your daily activities?
No, I haven't noticed any changes in my mood, energy, or ability to enjoy my daily activities. All of my stress and focus are completely centered on what my family is doing behind my back.

Other than the conflicts with your family members, have you ever felt that your behaviors or choices are being influenced by an outside force, or that people are sending you special messages through television, radio, or signs in your environment?
No, I have never felt influenced by any outside forces, and I don't get any messages from the TV, radio, or signs. My concerns are strictly about my family and that lawyer plotting against me.

She denies hallucinations, thought broadcasting, or other psychotic symptoms. Her functioning remains intact in professional and volunteer domains, and there is no evidence of a mood disorder or other medical/substance-related etiology.
